summary.name: Flat Vector Illustration. This is a supplemental design reference in the Drawing and Illustration category, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Clear flat color fields, simplified figures, and consistent corner radii define the look, with three to five main colors and one fixed accent. Icons, outlines, and typography stay proportionally consistent. Using SVG alone does not establish this aesthetic, and the visual details were not verified in a source video.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly stated: flat vector works alone for most explainers and brand pieces. Explicitly suggested hybrids are product-UI demos with style-095 and quantitative scenes with style-097. Inferred: illustrated narratives and icon-led scenes also suit this flat, readable treatment.
summary.limitations: Avoid photorealistic reflections, complex materials, and inconsistent shadows. Two-color contrast checks do not cover images, textures, video, or animated backgrounds, so recheck composited frames. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames cannot meet a requirement; an existing React project alone is insufficient. Motion references are optional and should be skipped when the scene lacks the needed assets.
summary.palette: These are suggested tokens, not supplied brand colors: background #F7F3E9, foreground #243746, accent_1 #267D82, accent_2 #DD7353, and accent_3 #EAC664. Keep these five fixed as the only main colors, and keep gradients disabled. Foreground text on background measures 11.083:1 and passes. Foreground text on accent_3 measures 7.462:1 and passes. Background text on accent_1 (4.369:1) and foreground text on accent_2 (3.89:1) fail normal text, so use those pairs as decorative fills only. #DD7353 is the fixed coral accent and CTA color. Task-supplied exact colors override these tokens, and only notation may be normalized.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Motion relies on movement, masks, decomposition, and meaningful morphs, with staged entrances and held key text. Easing is optional; deliberate sharp cuts, impacts, constant-speed sections, and reading holds should be kept. Motion references are optional, and phrase, punctuation, and burst actions apply only when scene assets support them. Video motion must derive from composition time, while hover, scroll, and pointer behavior applies only to interactive delivery.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified in this metadata, so no music, voiceover, or effects are assigned. Inferred: restrained music or silence could suit the clean flat look and leave room for reading holds. Any speech must stay intelligible without competing vocals. Source reviews verified no audio beat synchronization, so beat-matched cuts require inspecting real audio first. Do not impose a fixed genre or mandatory audio layer.
summary.assetRequirements: No artwork, fonts, or exact copy are specified in this metadata. Load fonts and SVG geometry before rendering. Use task-approved palette values, or the suggested tokens only when no palette is provided. Motion references require the actual illustration, geometry, and suitable layers or a rig. Punctuation and phrase actions need real punctuation or phrase assets; do not invent copy or brand marks.
summary.combinations: style-095 pairs flat devices with UI screen motion and suits app launches, SaaS explainers, and feature tours. Keep corner radii and palette tokens consistent, avoid glass or realistic shadows, and use #DD7353 for CTAs. style-097 pairs flat charts with honest scales for impact reports and market overviews. Use only primary tokens, no more than three series, no gradients or 3D bars, and no invented data.
summary.productionApproach: SVG primitives and groups are the default style renderer, with PixiJS, tldraw, Cytoscape.js, or Paper.js optional only where a specific need exists. GSAP is the recommended motion engine, with Motion, mo.js, or Anime.js optional; assign one owner per animated property. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition, timing, audio sync, validation, and export, with Remotion as fallback only. Drive all layers from shared, seekable time and verify direct, forward, and backward seeks.
